author: Inside Edition
description: Alex Wilson-Garza from Round Rock, Texas, shares her story about having a stroke to educate and make others aware of the medical emergency. When her stroke symptoms began, her husband rushed her to her place of employment, St. David's Round Rock Medical Center. Coworkers worked quickly to save her life. Now she's teamed up with the American Stroke Association to share her story for American Stroke Month. Inside Edition Digital's Andrea Swindall has more.
title: Texas Nurse Becomes The Patient After Having A Stroke At 24
